title: Serialize PostgreSQL schema creation during multi-service startup
problem: A clean devcontainer run intermittently failed API readiness. Concurrent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calls can race on PostgreSQL catalog inserts.
contribution: AI-assisted diagnosis and implementation under the owner's direction: reproduce eight concurrent initializers against an isolated real PostgreSQL schema, add transaction-scoped schema advisory locks, add a regression test, and include gateway/bridge readiness in the API health contract.
ai_assistance: Codex implemented and executed the reproduction and fix; personal attribution remains for owner review.
outcome: All eight concurrent initializers completed after the lock was added. The clean devcontainer and integrated acceptance checks are rerunning against the corrected startup path.

tradeoffs.decision: Use a transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock for schema initialization
tradeoffs.benefit: Serialize catalog writes across API and worker startup without a separate migration service
tradeoffs.cost: This fixture still uses application bootstrap DDL; production migrations should be managed separately

tradeoffs.decision: Require gateway and ledger bridge readiness before API readiness
tradeoffs.benefit: The launcher no longer advertises a usable platform before required dependencies respond
tradeoffs.cost: A dependency outage intentionally makes platform health fail

limitations: Controlled fixture verification; production database migration and identity work remain separate
